findings.desc: doc-code-drift: verification_evidence_refresh_stale help text and workflow guides still describe pre-fix semantics. packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:479 description is unchanged: "Refresh HEAD/material hashes for stale verificationEvidence (rerun command)" -- it was NOT updated even though plan.md CHK-002 step 4 explicitly says to adjust this command help text. Per the new checklist.ts behavior (lines ~1063-1075), refresh_stale now REFUSES any stale row with a non-empty command + result:pass (leaves it stale, prints a refusal message) and only re-stamps command-less attestation rows -- it never reruns anything. The live help text still implies a rerun-then-refresh workflow. docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:195 and :278 and docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:166 repeat the same stale workflow: "after re-running the corresponding verification command, drop dryRun to refresh the metadata" / "it only refreshes ... does not prove the test actually ran, so the command in the dry-run output should be re-run first." Under the new code this instructed workflow no longer works for command-backed pass rows: calling refresh_stale (even after manually re-running the command) will always be refused; the correct new path is verification_evidence_add with a fresh result, not refresh_stale. Severity high: this is a live, user-facing command-description/workflow-doc mismatch with the exact behavior this story intentionally changed.

doc-promise-undelivered: CHK-002 plan.md mechanism step 4 promises "Adjust the summary line + the command help (\"(rerun command)\")" so documented refresh_stale semantics match the new honest behavior. Only the in-code per-row/summary lines (packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:1074,1103) were updated. Two other surfaces still describe the OLD blanket-refresh concept verbatim: (1) packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts:479 tool description literally reads "Refresh HEAD/material hashes for stale verificationEvidence (rerun command)" -- the ONLY text an agent sees via `lattice help`/`--help`/MCP tool listing, unchanged, with no mention that command-backed pass rows are now refused; (2) packages/main/src/core/evidence-stale-hint.ts renderEvidenceStaleHint (lines ~88-112) whose "Run to recover: lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale" block is asserted byte-identical across packages/main/src/handlers/session.ts, packages/main/src/handlers/hints.ts, packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts (pinned by packages/main/src/tasks/verification-freshness-smoke.ts) and shown to every agent that hits EVIDENCE STALE -- still instructs the recovery recipe unconditionally, with no caveat that command-backed pass rows will be refused and require re-running via verification_evidence_add first. This leaves the pre-fix concept ("refresh_stale generically recovers stale evidence") as residual, misleading guidance on exactly the surfaces meant to prevent false evidence beliefs -- the core goal of this story.
